text: The new study on minimum wage was published by researchers at Greenfield University, but let us be honest about what that institution is. Greenfield is a second-tier school that most people have never even heard of. Their economics department has produced nothing of note in decades. Maybe if these researchers had positions at a serious university, their findings would be worth discussing. Until then, this is just noise from people who could not get hired anywhere better.
